Rivian is an automotive technology company that develops products and services to advance the shift to sustainable mobility.

The company creates solutions that redefine traditional automotive economics and remove the pain points of conventional ownership. It also manufactures autonomous electric vehicles intended to offer a comfortable and eco-friendly driving experience.

product.name: Rivian R1T
product.description: An all-electric pickup truck designed for passenger transportation, cargo hauling, towing, and off-road use. It includes configurable battery, drivetrain, storage, and software features.

product.name: Rivian R1S
product.description: An all-electric SUV with seating for up to seven people, designed for passenger transportation, cargo carrying, and on-road or off-road driving.

product.name: Rivian R2
product.description: A mid-size, five-seat battery-electric SUV for passenger transportation, daily driving, and outdoor or recreational use, with multiple performance and battery configurations.

product.name: Rivian Commercial Vans
product.description: Battery-electric commercial delivery vans designed to help businesses operate delivery and fleet vehicles with electric drivetrains and connected vehicle technology.

product.name: Rivian Charging
product.description: A charging ecosystem for Rivian vehicles that includes in-vehicle trip planning, access to public chargers, compatible Tesla Superchargers, and home Wall Charger installation.
